parameters.name: ExeConfig
parameters.description: The execution method for the playbook. This parameter is in the JSONObject format.

parameters.name: InputParams
parameters.description: The input parameter configuration for the playbook. This parameter is in the JSONArray format.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response messages.

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: OutputParams
parameters.description: Playbooks do not support output parameter configurations. This parameter is fixed to an empty value.

parameters.name: ParamType
parameters.description:
The type of the input parameter for the playbook.

- **template-ip**: IP request template.

- **template-file**: file request template.

- **template-process**: process request template.

- **custom**: custom parameter.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
